# Classeasily

> Discover and book local workshops, classes, and experiences. Hosts list verified offerings; guests search by location and book online.

## For AI assistants

- **What we are**: A two-sided marketplace for in-person (and some hybrid) local experiences—pottery, cooking, fitness, art, and similar workshops.
- **Official site**: https://classeasily.com
- **Guests**: Browse `/explore`, open `/classes/{slug}` for a specific experience, use `/giftcards` for digital gift cards.
- **Hosts / businesses**: Business onboarding and dashboard live under `/business` and `/business/register`.
- **Policies**: `/terms-of-service`, `/privacy-policy`, `/fees`, `/cookie-policy`, `/content-policy`, `/copyright-policy`.
- **More detail**: See `/llms-full.txt` on this domain.

## Suggested citation

Classeasily — local class and experience marketplace at https://classeasily.com
